root_cause: After Wave 007, clade-tablecloth still used /tmp in six unit tests, clade-improve tests used panic! markers, and there was no automated gate preventing /tmp regressions.
fix_pattern: Migrate clade-tablecloth tests to tempfile::tempdir(); replace clade-improve test panic! with assert!(matches!(...)); add tmp-zero-gate ring with walkdir-based workspace scan.
lessons: The last holdouts for a policy are often in older rings; a dedicated gate binary makes the policy self-sustaining.
Test-only panic! markers should be treated the same as production panic surfaces when the codebase adopts a panic-free style.
Pre-existing Unicode placeholders ([U+23ED], [U+2190]) in source must be cleaned before seal even if they were not introduced this wave.
Walkdir-based gates are simple to implement and avoid shell scripts on the critical path (L7 UNITY).
